content: Muchi kaworpa chongtekak

Jesu ning Galilee tuitham panga minchuna aleiphut nok. Ama akolla anhong kinchun mipui ngaikha antam hei jarra amaning rukuong sunga alut a alei kin ong. Rukuong kha tuichung a aleiom, khan mipui ngaining tuipanga anleikintup.
Amaning chongtekak ngai aneiman a anmanideng chong katamtak aleiminchu, khan anmanideng aleiti:
<<Rangairu! Phakhat a mipa ning muchiru kaworsik a aleisuok.
Amaning lei a muchiru kha aheiworkar, alek ning lampui sirra ata, khan wa ngaining anhonga a anleibak.
Alek ning lungkarra leipil tomna khan aleita. Muchiru kha kinranga ahongmong, ajarchu leipil kha lei kinthuk mak.
Khan, kini ahongsuok karra, muchikek ngaikha akinwoi a aleicharjei; ajarchu anrujung kha akinthuk a alutmak jarra.
Muchiru alekning riling-bil karra aleita, anhongmong takkha riling ning aleidiip a, kara leineimuk.
Takkha muchiru alekchu leipil thana-a aleita, muchiru ngaikha anhongkek a, anhong kin-son khan kara anhongnei, alekning somthum, somruk, khan alekning reijakhat anhongkinra.>>
Khan Jesu ning atorna aleiti, <<Kour ninnei inchu hiwahi rangai ru!>>
Chongtekak ngai ajar
Jesu kha abinga aleiom lai, achong leikajet alek ngaile athiemroi somle-inni ngai amadeng anheiwa khan Chongtekak ngaikha kinchenna rilchen nasik amadeng anleirakal.
Jesu ning aleimasang, <<Pathien Rengram jarra akin-iip ngaikha anape jei.>> Takkha tu inum tolla kaom milak ngaisik chu, chongtekak hining hiwa rikip ngaihi anjetsik,
khawa jarra,

content.text: Kha-ang antho inchu, anmani ning Pathien deng anheikir noksik,
khan amaning anmani ngaikha arangai mindamsik.> >>

content: Jesu ning muchi kaworpa chongtekak aril minchen
Khan Jesu ning anmanideng aleirakal, <<Hiwa chongtekak hi nangni ning jetlei mo nin e? Kha inchu, nangni ning alak chongtekak ngai kho-ongmo ninjet torsik?
Muchi kaworpa ning Pathien chongkha awor.
Miring alek khachu lampui-sir a akata muchi ngaikhale akin-ang; anmani ning khawa chongkha kinranga anjetli, Seitan khan aheiwali amulung sunga kaom chongkha akhekjei.
Miring alek ngaining lungkarra akata muchi khale akin-ang. Anmani ning khawa chongkha kinranga anjetli, rokpui tak a anleiralang.
Takkha anmani mulung kinthuk a leilutmak, ajarchu anmani akasot a leidei tormuk. Khawa chong jarra khan, pongna a-imakli minpongna aheiwakar khanchu, anmani ning kinremma anmoso.
Miring alek ngaikha riling bil karra akata muchi khale akin ang. Anmani ngaihi chong kajetjei ngaikha an-e,
takkha hiwa ringkho sik a mulung pongna, neile hoi kumunom, khan alalak munomna rikip ngaikha ahonglut a, khawa chongkha anminmang, khan anmani ning kara neimuk.
Takkha miring alek khachu leithoi thana munna anwor muchi khale ankin-ang. Anmani ning chongkha anrangai, anleiralang, khan kara annei: alekning somthum, somruk, khan alekning reijakhat akara.>>
Taidon thoia thangmei
Jesu ning arilminjom, <<Tu inkhat ning thangmei aheichoi a Taidon thoia a-imakli phenchung thoi a anda ngaimi? Thangmei mutungna chunga anda-ngai ileimi?
Alei kinthup ngaikha alahong kinlar sik e, khan alei kinkhu rikip ngaikha ala kinlong sik e.
Kuor kanei ning hiwahi rangairu!>>
Amaning anmanideng aleiti, <<Nangni ninjet ngaikhan kinsing theiru! Nangni ning mi ngai chunga chong nintan anga nangni dengnum Pathien ning atansik e, takkha akikheldet sik e.
Alek akanei ngaikha khella akinpe sik, khan akanei phitmak ngaikha ama anei alekkha akinkhek del sik e.>>
Aheikomong muchi tekak
Jesu ning aleirilnok, <<Pathien Rengram khachu hi-ang e, mipa inkhat ning ama leipuk a muchiru awor khale akin-ang.
Amaning jaanna ajal, suun eli athei sik, khan khawa awor muchiru ngaikha anheikek a anheimong. Kha inum amaning kho-ongmo aheimonga aheikhang e ti leijetmak.
Leipil khaning muchikek ngaikha aminmong khan anheikara; amasatak adon anheisuok, khanchu aheiper, khan atorna a sawui katha kha akara.
Sang kha aminkara, mipa ning koite ning sang ka-at aleiphut, ajarchu sang-at phakha aheitungjei.>>
Ancham ru chongtekak
Jesu ning aleirakal,

content.text: <<Pathien Rengram hi anglemo akin-ang niti sik? Eini ning ang chongtekak mo nineiman li niril minchen sik e?
Khawa khachu, Mipa khaning leithoichunga anchamru akisintak aru achoi a, khan leipilla awor khale akin-ang.
Apha alek so a ahongkomong anser-leina ngai karra akaloktak inkhat ahongchang. Khan abaak kolok ngai ahongsuok a khawa khan wa ngaining anrubu anleisak.>>

content: Jesu ning ama chongkha mi ngaideng aleiril, hiwa anga chongtekak katamtak ngaihi aneimanna; amaning anmani anjettor laiseng aleirilpe.
Amaning chongtekak kinchallei a anmanideng ite inkhat num leirilpe mak, takkha ama thiemroi ngaile bei an om karkhan, amaning kinchenna angrikip ngaikha anmanideng aleirilpe.
Jesu ning phaiwopui amindai
Khawa nitak kholeiteng khan Jesu ning athiemroi ngaideng aleiti, <<Eini tuitham ralkhat teng kai inlang se rangri.>>
Khawa jarra anmani ning mipui ngaikha aleimathaan; athiemroi ngaining Jesu alei chuongna rukuong khan anlut a, khan anmani ning amakha anleiroi. Rukuong aleknum khawa munkhan aleiom.
Jetlei theilei a phaiwo pui karat inkhat ahongranga, tui akinnok khan rukuong pangkha ahong jemma tuikulut aleiphut, rukuong kha tuining hongsip sik aleitho.
Jesu ning rukuong nukteng khan, montum aneia aleijal. Athiemroi ngaining ama ankeithei a anleiti, <<Oja, keini thisik kintijei nadonlei sikmo ni-e?>>
Jesu ning angir a phaiwo dengkhan chong aleipe, <<Omchenro!>> khan amaning tuikinnok dengkhan aleiti, <<Kinnok maro!>> phaiwo kha rangmak jei, khan arikip ahongdaijei.
Khan Jesu ning athiemroi ngaideng aleiti, <<Angsikmi kha-angtuk ninchi e? Tunkutung nangni taksenna ninlaneimak e?>>
Takkha anmani ning anchi hei a inkhatle inkhat deng anlei-kinril, <<Hiwa mipa hi atumi? Phaiwo le tuikinnok ningnum amachong anjui hi!>>
